def process(fraud_reports) -> pd.DataFrame:
    df = fraud_reports.copy()
    df.columns = df.iloc[0]
    df = df.iloc[1:].reset_index(drop=True)
    df = df.dropna(how='all')
    df = df[df['State'].notna() & (df['State'] != '')]
    df['Reports per 100K Population'] = pd.to_numeric(df['Reports per 100K Population'].astype(str).str.replace(',', ''), errors='coerce')
    df['# of Reports'] = pd.to_numeric(df['# of Reports'].astype(str).str.replace(',', ''), errors='coerce')
    df = df.dropna(subset=['Reports per 100K Population'])
    df['Report Type'] = 'Fraud and Other'
    return df[['State', 'Reports per 100K Population', '# of Reports', 'Report Type']]
